mapper.select: SELECT id,payment_id AS paymentId,merchant_id AS merchantId,merchant,rider,items,food_cents AS foodCents, delivery_cents AS deliveryCents,paid_cents AS paidCents,refunded_cents AS refundedCents, food_refunded_cents AS foodRefundedCents,payment_status AS paymentStatus,fulfill_status AS fulfillStatus, refund_status AS refundStatus,settlement_status AS settlementStatus,accepted,pending_refund AS pendingRefund, locking,payment_count AS paymentCount,paid_at AS paidAt,completed_at AS completedAt,closed_at AS closedAt, last_refund_at AS lastRefundAt,payment_last_refund_at AS paymentLastRefundAt,intervene, intervene_code AS interveneCode,intervene_reason AS interveneReason FROM business_order ORDER BY paid_at DESC

SELECT id,DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(created_at,'+00:00','+08:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, actor,actor_code AS actorCode,note,previous_status AS previousStatus,next_status AS nextStatus FROM order_note WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_cents),0) FROM business_order WHERE payment_status='PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED'

SELECT id,order_id AS orderId,payment_id AS paymentId,reason,type,amount_cents AS amountCents, status,channel_status AS channelStatus,channel_detail AS channelDetail,channel_reason AS channelReason,created_at AS createdAt, operator_code AS operatorCode,operator FROM refund_record ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT w.id,w.applicant,w.applicant_type AS applicantType,w.amount_cents AS amountCents, w.status AS status,w.created_at AS createdAt,w.reason, CASE WHEN w.status='PENDING_REVIEW' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_audit_log a WHERE a.action_name='withdrawal.review' AND a.target_id=w.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM withdrawal_transfer t WHERE t.withdrawal_id=w.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reviewable, CASE WHEN w.status IN ('TRANSFERRING','AWAITING_CONFIRMATION') AND w.reason_code='WECHAT_FUNDS_INSUFFICIENT' AND t.status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN') AND t.channel_reference IS NULL AND NOT t.retry_requested THEN 'original' WHEN w.status='PAYOUT_FAILED' AND t.status='FAILED' AND t.channel_reference IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM withdrawal_request r WHERE r.request_key=CONCAT('payout-retry-',w.id)) THEN 'new' END AS retryMode, COALESCE(t.retry_requested,0) AS retryRequested, original.id AS originalWithdrawalId FROM withdrawal_request w LEFT JOIN withdrawal_transfer t ON t.withdrawal_id=w.id LEFT JOIN withdrawal_request original ON w.request_key LIKE 'payout-retry-%' AND original.id=SUBSTRING(w.request_key,LENGTH('payout-retry-')+1) ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.id
SELECT id,name,type,balance_cents AS balanceCents,frozen_cents AS frozenCents,status FROM finance_account ORDER BY id

SELECT id,order_id AS orderId,subject,type,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(food_cents/100,2)) AS foodAmount, CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(delivery_cents/100,2)) AS deliveryAmount,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(paid_cents/100, 2)) AS paidAmount,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(refund_cents/100,2)) AS refundAmount,settlement,settlement_detail AS settlementDetail,created_at AS time FROM finance_ledger ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT j.id,j.account_id AS accountId,a.name,j.event_type AS eventType,j.reference_id AS referenceId, j.request_key AS requestKey,j.debt_id AS debtId,j.available_delta AS availableDelta,j.frozen_delta AS frozenDelta, j.created_at AS time FROM account_journal j JOIN finance_account a ON a.id=j.account_id ORDER BY j.id DESC

SELECT d.id,d.order_id AS orderId,d.merchant,d.rider,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(d.rider_due_cents/100, 2)) AS riderDue,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(COALESCE(a.balance_cents,d.merchant_balance_cents)/100, 2)) AS merchantBalance,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(d.platform_advance_cents/100,2)) AS platformAdvance, CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(d.recovered_cents/100,2)) AS recovered,d.note FROM finance_debt d LEFT JOIN finance_account a ON a.id=d.merchant_account_id ORDER BY d.id

SELECT id AS configId,CONCAT('OPS-V',LPAD(id,GREATEST(3,CHAR_LENGTH(id)),'0')) AS version,fee_cents AS feeCents,food_rate AS foodRate, delivery_rate AS deliveryRate,fee_bps AS feeBps,food_fixed_cents AS foodFixed, delivery_fixed_cents AS deliveryFixed,regular_batch AS regularBatch,peak_batch AS peakBatch,service_start AS serviceStart, service_end AS serviceEnd,peak_start AS peakStart,peak_end AS peakEnd,accept_timeout AS acceptTimeout, reminder_interval AS reminderInterval,effective_at AS effectiveAt,operator FROM operations_config ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT start_time AS start,end_time AS end FROM operations_peak_period WHERE config_id=#{configId} ORDER BY start_time
